artifact: three fixed-map JSON factory blueprints; generators may use any available development language
objective: mean correct deliveries over three fixed 60-second simulations; lower total build cost breaks ties
randomness: none; fixed input ports and shapes, empty initial inventory, 60 Hz ticks, canonical placement order
generalization: fixed-instance optimization only; no held-out map generalization claim
continuation_policy: Same session continues until submission or a shared resource budget is exhausted; no separate continuation-count limit and no budget reset.
